thread:
Priya: pagerbot triggered: P0 - gpu-pool-exhaustion in us-west-2. Inference queue 'inference-prod' 11k -> 18k in 12m, error rate up.
Alan: getting paged, will join. @Sarah are you oncall?
Sarah: I'm oncall, joining. saw spike on metrics and autoscaler errors -> trying to attach nodes but they're NotReady.
Sarah: logs from cluster-autoscaler:
```
E0623 09:12:53 scale_up.go:245 AttachInstanceProfile failed for i-0abcd: UnauthorizedOperation: iam:PassRole
status code: 403, request id: 1234
```
Ivan: hmm AttachRole errors + also nodes that did spin up show kubelet crashloop with "failed to get token from IMDSv2". Possibly launch template has IMDSv2 enforced and instance profile not attached.
Priya: customer impact: traffic routed to dedicated hosts but those are saturated; some customers seeing 503s. Support already triaged 6 high-value customers flagged by customer-bridge.
Alan: steps I took: inspected ASG 'gpu-prod-asg-1' - DesiredCapacity=3 but Instances=0; nodes terminated during bootstrap.
Alan: `aws autoscaling describe-auto-scaling-groups --auto-scaling-group-names gpu-prod-asg-1` shows DesiredCapacity=3, Instances=0.
Sarah: kubectl get nodes shows several 'NotReady' nodes removed by kube-controller after failing bootstrap.
Sarah: kubectl describe failed node shows taints:
```
Taints: dedicated=gpu:NoSchedule, node.kubernetes.io/unschedulable:NoSchedule
```
Sarah: Launch template version mismatch: new LT (lt-1234) has AMI that boots ECS agent and uses custom userdata that doesn't start kubelet. Old LT used rki-gpu-optimized-ami.
Ivan: so two distinct failures: (1) AttachRole / iam:PassRole preventing instance profile being attached at launch, (2) launch template AMI/userdata mismatch causing kubelet not to register -> nodes removed and autoscaler keeps retrying.
Priya: timeline: spike started at 09:01, pager fired 09:12, partial mitigation started 09:18, manual scale + console fix 09:36. Impact window ~09:01-09:44.
Alan: mitigation plan executed:
- bumped ASG desired to +6 manually to force new instances (09:18)
- manually launched emergency launch template version (lt-1229) via console with correct AMI and instance profile (09:25)
- patched ASG to use lt-1229 (09:28)
- updated IAM role to allow iam:PassRole for autoscaler instance profile role via temp policy (09:30)
Sarah: after patch nodes started to join; kubelet registered, taints applied correctly. queue drained from 18k -> 2.5k over 10m. error rate dropped.
Ivan: also applied short-term autoscaler config change: lowered "max node provisioning rate" to avoid thrash, and increased toleration for kube-system taints so bootstrap jobs could run more reliably.
Priya: customer-bridge notes: informed 6 customers about mitigation and ETA, three requested status callbacks. Sales/CS looped in.
Alan: postmortem action items (initial):
- revert launch template gating workflow to require canary test (owner: infra-team)
- add unit test and gating for AMI/userdata differences (owner: eng-runtime)
- tighten IAM least privilege but allow autoscaler PassRole via cross-account role (owner: eng-infra)
- add automated smoketest that verifies node kubelet registration within 5m of ASG launch (owner: eng-sre)
- create runbook checklist for manual emergency LT rollback (owner: eng-oncall)
Sarah: handing off to next oncall @Ivan for monitoring window and follow-up. leaving context: nodes stable, queue trending down, no active pagers.
Ivan: I'll monitor for 2h and escalate to eng-runtime if any reoccurrence. Also will capture the failing instance logs and upload to shared incident dir.
Priya: tagging for postmortem and SLA credit assessment. Filing incident ticket and sending initial blameless summary to #incidents-postmortems.
ops-bot: Incident declared P0 by Priya at 2026-06-23T09:20:00Z, page escalation activated.
pagerbot: Auto-silenced by Sarah at 2026-06-23T09:40:00Z after mitigation.
customer-bridge: Notified impacted customers; two requested reimbursement review. Will coordinate with finance and legal.
Sarah: OK handoff complete. Next update in 30m or if anything new. :white_check_mark:
Alan: good work everyone, please add logs and timestamps to the ticket.
Ivan: uploading logs to s3://redwood-incidents/6231112223/ (will post link when done)
Priya: filing initial Incident report doc and scheduling postmortem 48h out. Thanks all.
